# Security Policy

## Reporting Security Vulnerabilities

We take the security of Division Config seriously.

If you discover a security vulnerability or sensitive information exposure, please report it responsibly:

- **Do not open public GitHub issues for security vulnerabilities.**
- Please report security concerns directly via GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting or by contacting the repository maintainers.

## Zero-Telemetry & Client-Side Privacy

Division Config operates as a client-side web application:
- No user tracking, analytics, or third-party cookies.
- Personal builds are stored in browser local storage and optionally synchronized directly with the user's own private GitHub repository (`my-division-builds`).
- No build data or private tokens are stored on any intermediary backend servers.
